question: How did the page number of the beginning of the MD&A section (Item 7) change for UPS from its 2022 filing to its 2024 filing?
answer: In the 2022 filing, the MD&A section begins on page 23; in the 2024 filing, it begins on page 25, an increase of 2 pages.
evidence_section: UPS FY2022 (Item 7+8): '23 UNITED PARCEL SERVICE, INC. AND SUBSIDIARIES MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS...' and UPS FY2024 (Item 7+8): '25 UNITED PARCEL SERVICE, INC. AND SUBSIDIARIES MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS...'

question: What is the difference in the number of pages covered by the MD&A section (Item 7) in GE's 10-K filings between fiscal year 2022 and fiscal year 2024, and which year had a larger section?
answer: For fiscal year 2022, the MD&A covers pages 6-29 (24 pages). For fiscal year 2024, it covers pages 8-24 (17 pages). The 2022 section is larger by 7 pages.
evidence_section: GE FY2022 (Item 7+8): 'Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations 6-29' and GE FY2024 (Item 7+8): 'Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations 8-24'

question: What is the change in the starting page number of the MD&A section from fiscal year 2022 to 2024 for UPS and GE, and which company experienced a larger increase?
answer: For UPS, the starting page increased from 23 in 2022 to 25 in 2024, an increase of 2 pages. For GE, the starting page increased from 6 in 2022 to 8 in 2024, an increase of 2 pages. Both companies experienced the same increase.
evidence_section: UPS: '23 ...' (2022) and '25 ...' (2024); GE: '6-29' (2022) and '8-24' (2024). Starting pages inferred from the page range text.
